incident: A misrouted worker assignment overwrote already pinned Luna draft51 while addendum54 was requested. The accepted primary51 remained unchanged.
restoration: Root restored only the exact original draft bytes after independent SHA256 comparison. The changed late version and original recovery copy remain preserved. No accepted historical decision or requirement was revised.
recovery_provenance: Worker regenerated the earlier candidate using preserved /private/tmp/build_add51.py with output redirected to a new recovery path; exact hash matches the value pinned before the incident.
prevention: Worker assignments must use the requested new addendum number, fail if destination already exists, and never rerun old authoring scripts against accepted or pinned inputs.
